notes: Healing on low health via the Heal and High Heal skills (Skills slot option hpbelow=<percent>). The hunting anchor now follows your kills instead of camping where you armed, so it works its way across a map. The death brake is configurable (Bot/MaxDeathsPerHour, Bot/HaltResumeMinutes) and resumes by itself instead of needing a game restart. Setup writes steam_appid.txt so a helper launched game can still find Steam. New read only instruments for movement, loot and inventory. Module SVInject 1.17.0.
